risk_weights._doc: Nonnegative weights that MUST sum to 1.0. P (verified policy evidence) is weighted highest because it is the most evidence-grounded signal; S (suspicious sequence) next; A (statistical anomaly) lowest because it is the weakest/most environment-dependent signal.

thresholds._doc: Risk-score bands (0-100). These gate the DESCRIPTIVE risk band only; they never override the visibility-aware verdict layer.

anomaly._doc: A (0-1) = share of a stream's events that are anomalous versus a frequency baseline fitted ONLY on designated baseline data (benign control A7 + baseline-config streams). Missing events never raise A.

sequence_patterns._doc: Each pattern contributes a severity (0-1) to S = max(severity of triggered patterns). Patterns require specific canonical event types + fields and are isolated to one trial/stream to avoid cross-trial correlation.

verdict_policy._doc: Visibility-aware verdict precedence (highest first). A high risk_score NEVER overrides a collection/execution failure.
